_comment: Hand-derived expectations over records/*.json plus the ledger entry {period: 2026-11} -> task-split-b the suite appends (spec 0210, PLAN v2 step 12). Token sums follow D4's one placement rule: one contributing pass over the selection (each session-cumulative session contributes its last snapshot only), then placement by requestInstant.

gapsScope._comment: --session sess-gaps: one unpriced (r12), one uncaptured (r13), one priced (r14). Unpriced tokens stay in the token sums (R8 interpretation, D3); only r14 is priced: 100 * 3e-6 + 10 * 15e-6 USD.

cleanScope._comment: --session sess-alpha: neither an uncaptured nor an unpriced record; r01 alone is 1000 * 3e-6 + 200 * 15e-6 = 0.006 USD.

splitTasks._comment: sess-split's October snapshot keeps task-split-a; the ledger {period: 2026-11} entry moves every November record to task-split-b. Per-key passes (D4): a = r15 alone, b = r16 + r18.

divergence._comment: Case 13.8: usage:query --period P --rollup filters first; the dashboard's --period places the one pass's contributions.
